## Appearance

Ned Land is a tall, strongly built man standing over six feet high. Around forty years of age, he presents a grave and taciturn demeanor.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER IV NED LAND P8](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0008)_

## Personality

A strongly built Canadian man over six feet tall, Ned Land is generally grave and taciturn, though he can become passionate when contradicted and succumb to violent instincts. He possesses exceptional quickness of hand in his dangerous profession and is skilled at cooking, yet he remains driven by a persistent craving for meat and a firm determination to escape captivity.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER IV NED LAND P7](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0007), [v1 CHAPTER IV NED LAND P8](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0008), [v1 CHAPTER X THE MAN OF THE SEAS P37](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0037), [v1 CHAPTER XX A FEW DAYS ON LAND P74](../source/v01-c20.md#nw-v01-c20-p0074), [v1 CHAPTER XXI CAPTAIN NEMO’S THUNDERBOLT P67](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0067), [v1 CHAPTER XXI CAPTAIN NEMO’S THUNDERBOLT P101](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0101)_

## History

Ned Land, an expert Canadian harpooner whose family originated from [Quebec](../codex/places.md#quebec), joined the search for a mysterious sea monster aboard the [Abraham Lincoln](../codex/tech.md#abraham-lincoln). After months of searching, Ned spotted the creature at night and struck it with his harpoon, causing a sudden deluge and collision that ultimately resulted in him, [Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md), and [Conseil](../character/conseil.md) climbing onto the metallic surface of what was actually a submarine. The men were brought inside and imprisoned, where a frustrated Ned lost his temper and throttled a steward before Captain Nemo appeared and informed them they would remain captives on the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) forever. While held aboard the vessel, Ned observed underwater sea life through its observation windows but declined to join an undersea hunting expedition on [Crespo](../codex/places.md#crespo) Island. He later secured permission with [Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md) and [Conseil](../character/conseil.md) to go ashore on the Island of [Gilboa](../codex/places.md#gilboa), where they gathered wild food and discussed escaping before being attacked by native [Papuans](../codex/factions.md#papuans). Upon returning to the submarine, Ned attempted to touch the hatches during the assault but was repelled by the ship's electrified railing, and he was later drugged and locked away along with his companions when [Nemo](../character/nemo.md) abruptly confined them.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER IV NED LAND P6](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0006), [v1 CHAPTER IV NED LAND P9](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0009), [v1 CHAPTER IV NED LAND P12](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0012), [v1 CHAPTER IV NED LAND P13](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0013), [v1 CHAPTER IV NED LAND P24](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0024), [v1 CHAPTER V AT A VENTURE P13](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0013), +55 more_

## Quotes

> “Wooden ships—that is possible,” replied the Canadian, “but I have never seen it done; and, until further proof, I deny that whales, cetaceans, or sea-unicorns could ever produce the effect you describe.”
>
> — Ned Land — [v1 CHAPTER IV NED LAND P19](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0019)

> "You have convinced me of one thing, sir, which is that, if such animals do exist at the bottom of the seas, they must necessarily be as strong as you say."
>
> — Ned Land — [v1 CHAPTER IV NED LAND P37](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0037)

> "The Captain must be very sure of his route, for I see there pieces of coral that would do for its keel if it only touched them slightly."
>
> — Ned Land — [v1 CHAPTER XIX TORRES STRAITS P13](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0013)

> "Sir, you may believe me when I tell you that this piece of iron will navigate neither on nor under the sea again; it is only fit to be sold for its weight. I think, therefore, that the time has come to part company with Captain Nemo."
>
> — Ned Land — [v1 CHAPTER XIX TORRES STRAITS P34](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0034)

> "But do they know, at least, how to act circumspectly? There is an island; on that island there are trees; under those trees, terrestrial animals, bearers of cutlets and roast beef, to which I would willingly give a trial."
>
> — Ned Land — [v1 CHAPTER XIX TORRES STRAITS P36](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0036)

## Relationships

### [Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/aronnax--ned-land.md)

Ned Land first met [Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md) aboard the [Abraham Lincoln](../codex/tech.md#abraham-lincoln), where they debated the existence of the sea monster prior to the voyage's climax. After Ned struck the creature with his harpoon, both men were cast into the sea and ended up imprisoned together on the submarine [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus). Though they are close friends and comrades in captivity, tension occasionally arises between them, such as when [Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md) had to intervene after Ned lost his temper and attacked a steward over their lack of food.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER IV NED LAND P6](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0006), [v1 CHAPTER IV NED LAND P11](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0011), [v1 CHAPTER IV NED LAND P12](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0012), +21 more_

- Comrade of — fellow captives on board the Nautilus  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER VIII MOBILIS IN MOBILI P34](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0034), [v1 CHAPTER XIII THE BLACK RIVER P18](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0018)</sub>
- Friend of — traveling companions aboard the Nautilus  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER IV NED LAND P11](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0011), [v1 CHAPTER XIX TORRES STRAITS P28](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0028)</sub>

### [Conseil](../character/conseil.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/conseil--ned-land.md)

Ned Land shared the search for the monster alongside [Conseil](../character/conseil.md) aboard the [Abraham Lincoln](../codex/tech.md#abraham-lincoln) before Ned spotted the creature in the [Pacific](../codex/places.md#north-pacific). After being thrown overboard, Ned found refuge atop the metallic surface of the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) and helped pull [Conseil](../character/conseil.md) and [Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md) to safety. The two now endure captivity together on the vessel as friends and cabin mates, with [Conseil](../character/conseil.md) present when Ned reached his breaking point and throttled an incoming steward.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER IV NED LAND P6](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0006), [v1 CHAPTER IV NED LAND P12](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0012), [v1 CHAPTER IV NED LAND P13](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0013), +31 more_

- Comrade of — fellow prisoners held on board the Nautilus  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XIII THE BLACK RIVER P18](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0018), [v1 CHAPTER XIII THE BLACK RIVER P19](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0019), [v1 CHAPTER XIV A NOTE OF INVITATION P5](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0005), +1 more</sub>
